series.title: New South Wales BESS earn nearly AU$6 million as two-hour ‘extreme’ price event sweeps Australia’s energy market
series.summary: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) in Australia’s New South Wales (NSW) earned an estimated AU$5.63 million (US$3.88 million) in two hours on 12 October, as wholesale electricity prices peaked at AU$23,107/MWh.

series.title: Samsung C&T refers 800MWh Darnum BESS in Victoria’s Gippsland region to Australia’s EPBC Act
series.summary: Samsung C&T’s Australian renewables arm has referred an 800MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) in Victoria’s Gippsland region to the federal government under Australia’s Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation (EPBC) Act.

series.title: Wärtsilä energy storage JV Valo in US domestic content manufacturing discussions with ‘strong players’
series.summary: Valo, the new joint venture formed as a continuation of Wärtsilä’s energy storage business, is weighing up investing in the US supply chain, including factories.

series.title: Neoen, BW ESS and MN8 back efforts to standardise BESS procurement through new Energy Storage Contract Alliance
series.summary: Big names in the downstream battery storage market have signed up to join an initiative aimed at simplifying BESS procurement.

series.title: Clearway Energy increases Utah ‘Energy Centre’ capacity to 2,120MWh
series.summary: Independent power producer (IPP) Clearway Energy has added 210MW of energy storage capacity to its Honeycomb Energy Centre fleet in Southern Utah, US.

series.title: Foss & Company closes US$58 million tax equity deal for GridStor’s Texas BESS project
series.summary: US tax equity syndicator Foss & Company has closed a US$58 million partnership flip transaction to finance an energy storage project in Hidalgo County, Texas, developed by GridStor.

series.title: Battery system failures fell 98% in 7 years, but older systems need special care: report
series.summary: The Electric Power Research Institute analysis found a dramatic drop in energy storage system failures from 2018 to 2025 amid a host of technology and project improvements. “Early-vintage” systems may require retrofits, however.

series.title: Merchant exposure divides BESS investors in Japan, Singapore and Australia, DLA Piper finds
series.summary: DLA Piper finds merchant BESS appeal splits Japan, Singapore and Australia, with regulatory certainty, grid access and returns shaping investor views.

series.title: ‘Mexico’s mixed investment scheme provides clean energy investors with certainty’
series.summary: Alberto Valenzuela discusses ahead of Energy Storage Summit Latin America about Mexico's growing interest in renewables and energy storage, and the factors driving this growth.

series.title: Europe’s battery market isn’t ready for second-life BESS business models yet
series.summary: Europe is no longer betting on second-life repurposing of EV batteries for stationary BESS applications, and that is not a bad thing, argues David Oudsandji, CEO of Voltfang.

series.title: South Africa’s state utility Eskom opens selection process for 1.5GW/21GWh pumped hydro plant
series.summary: South Africa continues its push for energy storage capacity, with utility and grid operator Eskom issuing a call to work on a 21GWh pumped hydro energy storage (PHES) project.

series.title: LTSAs under scrutiny: what BESS owners really need from their contracts
series.summary: A panel of BESS industry experts discussed the ins and outs of long-term service agreements (LTSAs) at the Battery Asset Management Summit UK & Ireland 2026 yesterday.

series.title: Illinois seeks feedback after coming up short in large-scale battery storage procurement
series.summary: The Illinois Power Agency (IPA) is seeking stakeholder feedback on its summer procurement of 600MW of energy storage projects in the US state, after falling short by 438MW.

series.title: PJM plans to study SoftBank’s Ohio AI project under state agreement approach

series.title: World falls well short on commitment to energy storage despite increased ambitions, think tank Ember says

series.summary: BloombergNEF has cut its 2026 global solar installation forecast to 584 GW, down 10.8% from 2025, driven by a sharper-than-expected slowdown in China.
